summary: Requirements specification for the Mini Flask Bookmark Manager web application.
features: Add bookmark with title and URL
scope: Build a mini Flask web application that allows users to add, view, search, and delete bookmarks backed by SQLite storage with a clean HTML/CSS user interface.
acceptance_criteria: User can add a new bookmark by providing a title and valid URL, which saves to the SQLite database.
User can view a list of all saved bookmarks displaying their titles and clickable URLs on the main page.
User can delete an existing bookmark from the list and verify it is removed from SQLite persistence.
User can search saved bookmarks by title and view only the matching results.
The user interface is styled with clean and simple HTML/CSS.
